notes: Posted 3 June 2001, before Coruscant; the list has no Coruscant-set card, so the format is Premiere - Tatooine.

Starting cards as posted under 'Starting(9)': My Kind Of Scum / Fearless And Inventive ('MKOS/FAI'), Prepared Defenses, Power Of The Hutt, Well Guarded, Tatooine: Desert Heart, Tatooine: Jabba's Palace, There Is No Try & Oppressive Enforcement, Hutt Influence and No Bargain; these count toward the 60. Well Guarded is the starting Effect named by the Objective.
The section counts as posted (9 + 4 + 27 + 9 + 4 + 4 + 1 + 1) add to 59, and the list totals 59 as published.

Posted 'ao/wounded wookie' dested Abyssin Ornament & Wounded Wookiee (the strategy describes both halves and its destiny 7); '4lom w gun' dested 4-LOM With Concussion Rifle; 'Ig88 w gun' dested IG-88 With Riot Gun; 'fett w gun' dested Boba Fett With Blaster Rifle; 'Galid' dested Gailid; 'Bib' dested Bib Fortuna; 'cc engineer' dested Cloud City Engineer.

Posted 'Tatooine Jabbas Palace' and 'Audience Chamber' dested the Dark pages Tatooine: Jabba's Palace and Jabba's Palace: Audience Chamber; 'Tatoooine Palace Dungeon' dested Jabba's Palace: Dungeon; 'scum' dested Scum And Villainy; 'sail barge' dested Jabba's Sail Barge (a vehicle, posted under ships).
The description says the deck went undefeated in two tournaments, which are not named.
